study: Frozen, blinded eBOSS DR16 ELG official full-catalogue bit8 label-to-geometry audit
allowed_structural_metadata: column names, FITS TFORM and offsets
forbidden_observed_row_columns: any galaxy identity/photometry beyond allowed three
source_pixels: Exactly 37 source pixels AST-parsed and source-Git-blob-verified by frozen RA-orientation audit; no new list, no altered pixels
primary_comparison: All-row confusion counts between the published catalogue's mskbit bit 8 and source HEALPix 37-pixel membership for each of the four predeclared coordinate conventions; independently confirm native degrees and radians yield identical membership for all rows
permitted_outputs: full file and source SHA identities
aggregate TP/FP/FN/TN for each frozen convention
whether positive reference labels are present
diagnostic comparison of total labels against published 15
forbidden_outputs: individual observed target identifiers, redshifts or weights
any observed odd-sector vector, pair counts or correlations
classification_rule: If zero bit8-labelled rows or any provenance/format mismatch, stop or report unresolved. If positive labels are present, report aggregate conditional agreement for the released catalogue only. Do not label implementation as verified solely from catalogue agreement; additional official production-chain provenance would be needed. No mask application to science selection is authorized.
expected_result_counts: NOT DECLARED; do not fabricate 15 positive rows; 15 is published removed-target aggregate for diagnostic only
